caption_text: Figure 1. Kaplan-Meier estimates of mortality on the waiting list according to race. CI indicates confidence interval.

llm_detailed_description.data_representation: Shows survival probability over time for two racial groups (White and Black) on the liver transplant waiting list.
llm_detailed_description.key_patterns: The curve for White patients is consistently above the curve for Black patients, indicating better survival.
llm_detailed_description.main_conclusion: White patients had significantly better survival outcomes compared to Black patients.
llm_detailed_description.recreation_prompt_hint: Generate a Kaplan-Meier plot for two groups comparing survival over 10 years. Include p-value from log-rank test.
